name: vscode-sidebar-resize-half
description: Toggle the primary sidebar wide for AI chat panels like Copilot Chat, or compact to give the editor more room.

sidebarResizeHalf.resizeSteps.description: Fallback number of approximately 60-pixel increments to use when the window width cannot be read.

sidebarResizeHalf.minimumSidebarWidth.description: Assumed minimum primary sidebar width in logical pixels, used to calculate half of the current macOS window width.

sidebarResizeHalf.compactSizeMultiplier.description: Compact sidebar width as a multiple of the assumed minimum width.

sidebarResizeHalf.maximumSidebarRatio.description: Maximum fraction of the macOS window width used for the sidebar, ensuring the editor remains wider.

sidebarResizeHalf.smoothResize.description: Animate the sidebar resize step-by-step. When disabled, the sidebar jumps directly to the target size.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
